packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-15 - unverified blind image reading
No proposed identification or reading was present in my context before reading.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001.jpg, reduced overview)
- Overview shows two paper leaves side by side on black ground, with a colour checker and scale; a small separate paper slip at left (shows "rum", "230-3u"?, "nie"? - a label/scrap, partly in a later hand).
- Left leaf: pencil shelfmark at foot "Stams, StA, Frag. 230-2u" (modern). Face shown is blank (no visible writing), stained, ragged left edge, crack lower centre.
- Right leaf: pencil "Stams, StA, Frag. 230-1u". Paper, single column of German cursive (Kurrent) in brown ink, not a book hand. Large losses at lower right: two long vertical tears/missing strips through the lower half and the right edge torn away from about line 10 down.
- Two sections, each opened by a centred heading beginning "Forma ..." (upper heading reads approx. "Forma einer 14 tägigen Verschafft"?; second heading at mid-leaf "Forma [..] tägigen ..."). Each section begins with a large flourished "Ich" (Ich N: N: ...). Roughly 13 lines of text under the first heading, ~13 under the second.
- No rubrics, no glosses, no columns. Abbreviation "N:" used as placeholder for names (formulary/template). Tentative interpretation: a formulary of model documents (forms), not a literary text.

image-002.jpg: native tile, top-left of the LEFT leaf (230-2u). Blank paper; no writing, ruling or offset visible. Ragged left edge with small hole at top left. Nothing to transcribe.

image-003.jpg: native tile; left part = top-right of LEFT leaf (blank); right part = top-left of RIGHT leaf (230-1u), line openings only (overlaps with following tile presumably).
image-003 l.1 (heading)  Forma a[...]            (large flourished F)
image-003 l.2   Ich N: N: Pfleg[...]             (large flourished I/J of "Ich")
image-003 l.3   gerichts obrigke[...]
image-003 l.4   zu Erhaltenn ge[...]
image-003 l.5   welter (?) Herrschaf[...]
image-003 l.6   verschafft worde[...]
image-003 l.7   benantlichen 25[...]
image-003 l.8   Zinß zu 14. [...]
image-003 l.9   ohne weiters auf[...]
(next line cut at foot of tile)

image-004.jpg: native tile, top right of RIGHT leaf; overlaps image-003 (line openings lost at left edge of this tile; supplied in [] from image-003 where it shows them). Right edge torn from l.2 down.
image-004 l.1 (heading)  Forma aines (eines?) 14 tägigen Verschaffts (?).
image-004 l.2   [Ich] N: N: Pfleger der Herrschafft N: bekhenn vor Pfleg-
image-004 l.3   [ger]ichts obrigkhait wegen offentlich, das an heut dato
image-004 l.4   [zu e]rhaltenn gerichtlichen Verhör mit N: N: zu N: be-
image-004 l.5   [we]lter Herrschafft N: meiner pflegsverwaltung g?stlichen? (schriftlich? - uncertain last word, end torn)
image-004 l.6   [ver]schafft worden, dem Ersamen N: M: burger zu
image-004 l.7   [be]nantlichen 250 fl. aufstehendt verfallen Capital sa[mbt?]
image-004 l.8   [Zin]ß zu 14. tagen der negsten gewiß und unfehlb[ar]
image-004 l.9   [ohne] weitern aufhalt zu erlegen und zu bezallen.
(l.10 cut at foot)
image-005.jpg: native tile, middle-left of LEFT leaf. Blank paper, stains only. Nothing to transcribe.

image-006.jpg: native tile; left = LEFT leaf middle (blank); right = line openings of RIGHT leaf middle. l.1-3 overlap image-003 l.7-9 / image-004 l.7-9.
image-006 l.1   benantlichen 25[...]        (= image-004 l.7, overlap)
image-006 l.2   Zinß zu 14. [...]           (overlap)
image-006 l.3   ohne weitern au[...]        (overlap)
image-006 l.4   wolbenanter (wolbemelter?) [...]

image-006 l.6   Unter? und mit [...]

image-006 l.8   /: doch dem [...]
image-006 l.9   schaden :/ vorfro[...]?
image-006 l.10  bezahlen? der ge[...]     (uncertain)
-- blank space --
image-006 l.11 (heading)  Forma [...]
image-006 l.12  Ich N: N: Pfle[...]
image-006 l.13  [ger?]richt? wegen offentl[...]
(l.14 cut at foot)

image-007.jpg: native tile, middle of RIGHT leaf; l.1-3 overlap image-004 l.7-9. Right edge torn away; a hole (long vertical tear) begins at l.10 centre.
image-007 l.1   [be]nantlichen 250 fl. aufstehendt verfallen Capital sa[mbt]   (overlap)
image-007 l.2   [Zin]ß zu 14. tagen der negsten gewiß und unfehlb[ar]         (overlap)
image-007 l.3   [ohne] weitern aufhalt zu erlegen und zu bezallen.   [trace of letter at torn edge]
image-007 l.4   [wol]bemelter N: M: gerichtlichen hinwegziehen? a[...]
image-007 l.5   [...]khündt? und schreib(?) begert hat, und ihme f[...]
image-007 l.6   [Un]ter und mit mein? obbemelts? pflegerats? N:
image-007 l.7   [ob]rigkeit wegen hinfüro stellen eigen adeliche[n?]
image-007 l.8   /: doch dem [...]mbt (Ambt?), mir, meinen erben und [...]
image-007 l.9   [scha]den :/ verfertigt ertailt worden. U[...]
image-007 l.10  [Ur]khund? der gerichtsch[...hole...] alda N: N: den [...]
-- blank space --
image-007 l.11 (heading)  Forma [hole] [?]5? (or 8.?). tägigen Vorschaffts? (end torn)
image-007 l.12  [Ich] N: N: Pfle[ger hole] bekhenne vor Pfle[g-]
image-007 l.13  [geri]cht? wegen offentl[ich hole] demnach vor dis[em?] [...]
image-007 l.14  [...] [hole] [...]pflegsverwaltung (?)   (foot of tile, partly cut)
Notes: l.5 "schreib" might be part of a compound; l.6 words after "mit" cramped, tentative. /: ... :/ marks a parenthesis in l.8-9 (also image-006 l.8-9). Digit in second heading damaged; only final stroke + point visible.

image-008.jpg: native tile, lower-left of LEFT leaf. Blank; damaged ragged left/bottom edges, vertical crack; pencil "Stam[s...]" (modern shelfmark) at lower right. Nothing to transcribe.

image-009.jpg: native tile; left = foot of LEFT leaf (blank; pencil "Stams, StA, Frag. 230-2u"); right = line openings of second form on RIGHT leaf (pencil "Stams, StA, Frag. 230-1u" at foot). l.1-2 overlap image-006 l.12-13 / image-007 l.12-13.

image-009 l.2   [ger?]icht? wegen offentl[...]  (overlap)

image-009 l.12  &c? wolbemelte[r? ...]

image-010.jpg: native tile, lower part of RIGHT leaf (second form). Paper survives as three vertical strips separated by losses: strip A (left, line openings, = image-009), strip B (middle), strip C (right, a narrow tongue, only from l.5 down). Strips are separated by gaps, so text between them is lost. Line-by-line, strips separated by " | ".
image-010 l.1   [Ich] N: N: Pfle[...] | bekhenne vor Pfl[eg-]                      (= image-007 l.12)
image-010 l.2   [...] wegen offentl[ich] | demnach vor dis[em]
image-010 l.3   [zu] Stamb?, mein[er] | [Pf]legsverwaltung
image-010 l.4   [wor]den, dem [...] | [Ersa]men N: M: b[urger?]
image-010 l.5   [be]nantlichen 250 f[l.?] | aufstehendt verf[allen?] | [Cap]ital sa[mbt?]
image-010 l.6   [Zin]ß sambt d[...] | [...]versessen? zu 14 | [...] bezallen
image-010 l.7   [un]d aber er N: | dann mit Nach[...] | [...]s ist d[...]
image-010 l.8   [we]gen auff dem | [N]: M: weiters | [er]volgen? Ver[...]
image-010 l.9   [...]t wegen Nach[...] | [...]verfügung b[...] | [...], das er? [...]
image-010 l.10  [ih]me N: M: sel[...] | [...]chuldt innerhalb | tagen der neg[sten]
image-010 l.11  [ge]wiß und unfehl[bar] | ohne weitern auf[...] | bezallung thu[n?]
image-010 l.12  [...] wolbemelter | gerichtlich hinwegz[iehen?] | Caetera ut su[pra]
Notes: "Caetera ut su[pra]" (Latin) closes the second form. "versessen?" in l.6 strip B uncertain (could be "verwesten"); superscript mark over it. Below l.12 blank paper to the torn foot.

SECOND FACE
image-011.jpg: reduced overview of the other faces: left leaf pencil "Stams, StA, Frag. 230-2v", right leaf "Stams, StA, Frag. 230-1v" (reverse of the written leaf, mirrored damage). Small slip at left with a few cursive letters and pencil "230-3v". At overview scale both leaves show no text: 230-2v is stained/yellowed with a faint line along the top edge (possible offset, ruling or fold, not text); 230-1v is blank paper with no visible ink or show-through legible.

image-012.jpg: native tile, top-left of 230-2v. No writing. A fine horizontal line and a vertical line near the top and left edges form a frame/fold or pressed (dry-point?) margin line, not text. White scuff patches (paste or abrasion). Nothing to transcribe.

image-013.jpg: native tile, top-right of 230-2v and top-left of 230-1v. Both blank; no ink. Nothing to transcribe.

image-014.jpg: native tile, top-right of 230-1v. Blank; water-stain tide lines only. Nothing to transcribe.

image-015.jpg: native tile, middle-left of 230-2v. Blank; vertical margin line near left edge continues. Nothing to transcribe.

image-016.jpg: native tile, middle of 230-2v (right part) and 230-1v (left part, beside the large loss). Blank. Nothing to transcribe.

image-017.jpg: native tile, middle-right of 230-1v. Blank; no ink or legible show-through. Nothing to transcribe.

SUMMARY AND LIMITATIONS
- Packet = image-001 to image-040 (no image-041). Four faces: 230-1u/2u (overview 001, tiles 002-010), 230-1v/2v (overview 011, tiles 012-020), 230-4u (overview 021, tiles 022-030), 230-4v (overview 031, tiles 032-040).
- Text exists only on 230-1u and 230-4u. All other faces are blank (show-through, watermark, margin/fold lines only).
- Script: 17th-century-style German Kurrent (brown ink), not a book hand; Latin elements only in headings/closings ("Forma", "Caetera ut su[pra]", "Datum", "Novembris", "Capital", "Jurisdiction"). Placeholders "N:" / "N: N:" / "N: M:" for names.
- 230-1u: two model forms ("Forma ... tägigen Verschaffts"?), the second heavily damaged by long vertical losses; text between surviving strips is lost (image-010). Read essentially everything visible; most uncertain: image-004 l.5 last word, image-007 l.4-6, the digit in the second heading, image-010 l.6-9 strip C.
- 230-4u: one document under heading "Schätz? Fürpottzetl", ~13 lines, date line "den 1. Novembris 16[7?]4" and subscription "N. Statt?maister daselbst". Read fully; uncertain: heading first word, l.3 craft word, l.5-6, l.10-12 of image-027, place in "Datum ...", and the year digits.
- The small loose slip visible at left in overviews 001 and 011 (pencil "230-3u"/"230-3v") has a few cursive letters but no native-resolution tile in the packet, so it is unread. A dedicated crop of it would be needed.
- Year digits on 230-4u (image-027 l.13) would benefit from a tighter crop.
- I did nothing beyond the brief's rules; no web/search/other files. No proposed identification was in my context.
